note: Per building type and per OSM tag: footprint, storeys (building:levels), height, roof shape, materials, orientation and setback, measured from real small towns, for the procedural Blender buildings (lane A). "type:" keys are this study's business types (downtown_* = street-front commerce); "building:", "shop:", "amenity:", "craft:" keys are OSM tag values (a building counts under each of its tags and under the tags of the shops and amenities mapped inside it). Keys with fewer than 5 buildings are left out. Tag coverage is low in rural North America (see levels.tagged, height.tagged, roofShape.tagged): use the type keys for sizes and the tagged subsets for storeys and roofs.
